documents.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Financial Targets Reconfirmed
documents.excerpt: Board reconfirms cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services developed through digital channels; efficiency programme to absorb wage inflation.

documents.title: ECB Holds Deposit Rate at 2.00%
documents.excerpt: Markets price a flat deposit rate through 2026. 12M Euribor stabilised near 2.1%, ending the NII tailwind that lifted Finnish banks in 2023-24.

documents.title: Q3 Fund Flows — Net Subscriptions EUR 420M YTD
documents.excerpt: Net subscriptions led by fixed income and the Nordic Micro Cap fund. Monthly fund savings agreements up 11% via the mobile app; average monthly saving EUR 118.

documents.title: FP&A Session Prep — Anaplan Alternative on Snowflake
documents.excerpt: Agenda for 23 Oct with CDO and Chief Data Architect: driver-based income and cost planning on the actuals already in the Aktia DW on Snowflake; budget cycle currently 14 weeks.

documents.title: Pricing Tool Migration Plan — Oracle to Snowflake Postgres
documents.excerpt: Legacy Oracle pricing tool to migrate to Snowflake Postgres in H1 2026. Removes licence cost and manual price-list reconciliation in fund operations.

documents.title: Retail Channel Review — Branch Utilisation
documents.excerpt: 78% of retail transactions are digital. Nine branches in Inland & North average fewer than 25 visits per day; advisory-hub model piloted in Tampere with stable NPS.

documents.title: Financial Sector Collective Agreement 2025-27
documents.excerpt: General pay increase of 3.0% in 2026 plus local pots. For Aktia's personnel base this adds roughly EUR 3M of cost.

documents.title: Aktia Life — Solvency & Claims Update
documents.excerpt: Solvency ratio 178%. Risk & disability claims ratio improved 3pp YoY; unit-linked reserves tracking fund performance with a ~2-month lag.

documents.title: Institutional Mandate Shortlist — Nordic Credit
documents.excerpt: Two earnings-related pension companies shortlisted Aktia for a EUR 600M Nordic credit mandate. Final decision expected Q1 2027.

documents.title: AI Advice Copilot Pilot Results — Vaasa
documents.excerpt: Pilot with 12 private bankers cut meeting preparation time by 38% and lifted fund cross-sell by 9%. Proposal to extend to Helsinki and Turku in H2.
